# The currency's name: its word. Every country at the game's load (on_game_started_after_lobby,
# on_actions/ld_currency_name_on_actions.txt), then with zz_ef_cur_set and the currency laws' on_activate.
zz_ef_cur_names = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_cur } } zz_ef_cur_noun_set = yes }
	else = { zz_ef_cur_name_set = yes }
}

# The user: every currency is named «<the country's adjective> <word>» -- «Russian ruble, British pound»;
# the issuer of a country's currency is the country itself (Upper Canada on the pound -- «Upper Canadian pound»).
# The word of an E&F currency (var:zz_ef_cur_noun; a national one -- zz_ef_cur_noun_set, ld_currency_national.txt).

	else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:spe_yen } set_variable = { name = zz_ef_cur_noun value = flag:yen } }

	else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:thaler_prussian_thaler } set_variable = { name = zz_ef_cur_noun value = flag:thaler } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:thaler_saxon_thaler } set_variable = { name = zz_ef_cur_noun value = flag:thaler } }
	else = { zz_ef_cur_noun_set = yes }
}

# The issuer's gold a unit of its money held abroad (var:zz_ef_rq_gpm -- its value against the parity,
# zz_ef_value_to_parity, Д.R8а.4) and whether it counts in an exchange standard's cover (var:zz_ef_rq_conv -- the
# issuer redeems in metal, zz_ef_convertible_v, Д.R8а.5): the register of claims values the holdings by them
# (scripted_effects/ld_claims.txt). Monthly (zz_ef_money_model_monthly_step) and with zz_ef_cur_set; last month's, so
# two issuers holding each other's money do not read each other in a loop.
zz_ef_cur_par_update = {
	if = {
		limit = { zz_ef_nr_issuer = yes }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_rq_gpm value = zz_ef_value_to_parity }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_rq_conv value = zz_ef_convertible_v }
	}
}
